summary_en: Kaga Electronics reaffirms tender offer price of ¥1,580 per share for Shinko Shoji (8141), with offer period ending 14 July 2026. Price determined via independent third-party valuation (Deloitte Tohmatsu) dated 14 May 2026 and negotiation with target. Target board recommends offer. Offer aims to make Shinko Shoji wholly owned subsidiary. Financial impact on Kaga Electronics FY3/27 results not yet quantified.
title_en: Public tender offer for ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (Security Code: 8141) – Supplementary materials
translation_en_brief: Kaga Electronics filed this supplementary disclosure on 8 July 2026 to reaffirm its tender offer for all ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime, code 8141). The offer commenced 18 May 2026 at ¥1,580 per share, with the tender period set to close 14 July 2026. Kaga states the price was determined by independent third-party valuation by Deloitte Tohmatsu (dated 14 May 2026) and through negotiation with Shinko Shoji, and reflects the target's enterprise value and provides shareholders a reasonable opportunity to liquidate. The target's board, at its 15 May 2026 meeting, passed a resolution recommending the offer, viewing the transaction as contributing to the target's corporate value enhancement and the price as having rational basis. Kaga confirms no plan to revise the price despite temporary market trading above ¥1,580. The transaction aims to make Shinko Shoji a wholly owned subsidiary. Financial impact on Kaga's consolidated results for FY3/27 is under review and will be disclosed once quantified.
